subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI WebChat repeatedly prompts for gateway token after mobile browser is briefly backgrounded

question: Should mobile background/resume recovery retain only revocable endpoint-scoped device credentials, or may any shared gateway-token recovery state survive browser lifecycle suspension?
rationale: The correct repair changes the persistence and recovery boundary for gateway authentication credentials; source-adjacent work intentionally avoids persistent shared-token storage, so implementation cannot safely choose this policy alone.

options.title: Device credential only
options.body: Investigate and repair the Android resume path using the existing endpoint-scoped, gateway-issued device credential without persisting the shared token.

options.title: Explicit shared-token persistence
options.body: Permit a narrowly scoped persisted shared-token recovery mechanism only with an approved security model, revocation behavior, and migration proof.

options.title: Document unsupported lifecycle
options.body: Treat affected browser lifecycle/storage behavior as unsupported and document a secure recovery workflow instead of changing credential persistence.

recommendation.title: Device credential only
recommendation.body: Investigate and repair the Android resume path using the existing endpoint-scoped, gateway-issued device credential without persisting the shared token.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work owns the adjacent Control UI browser credential-scoping design.
